raw_response: {"sentences":[{"text":"From Stonewall Inn, make your way on to Greenwich Village, just ahead.","source_id":"GLUE_NAV","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":3},{"text":"For more than a hundred years, these crooked streets were the center of New York's lesbian and gay life, and a walk through them still passes landmark after landmark of that past.","source_id":"e6d038af-2739-4c02-972a-6db9f94cabb8","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"The city's literary life started near here too, with Washington Irving — the first American to make a living from writing.","source_id":"a303c811-5e60-4d5e-a41d-ab04ae784637","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"Born and raised in post-colonial Manhattan, and famous for \"Rip Van Winkle,\" he launched a satirical magazine called Salmagundi in 1807, and in its pages he coined \"Gotham\" as a nickname for New York — one that's clung to the city ever since.","source_id":"a303c811-5e60-4d5e-a41d-ab04ae784637","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"A century and a half later, Allen Ginsberg, Jack Kerouac, and their friends spent many a happy night at the Kettle of Fish, a bar still going at 59 Christopher Street.","source_id":"0112af18-cbb1-4b25-8e3a-bcb9ca85f4c6","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"Here's a question the Village keeps asking: what do you call a love the law won't name?","source_id":"66dabd79-3058-453c-b433-5c1133e80f60","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":3},{"text":"In 1777, one man wrote to another: 'I wish, my dear Laurens, it might be in my power, by action rather than words, to convince you that I love you.' The writer was Alexander Hamilton, and the letter went to a fellow soldier in the Continental Army.","source_id":"42b9ccc6-5927-4fd7-9aba-bbe4c622383b","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"Historians still argue over letters like these — the effusive same-sex correspondence of the 1700s and 1800s they call 'romantic friendships,' written in an intensely homosocial age.","source_id":"42b9ccc6-5927-4fd7-9aba-bbe4c622383b","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"You find the same warmth in the letters of Ralph Waldo Emerson, Margaret Fuller, and Susan B. Anthony.","source_id":"42b9ccc6-5927-4fd7-9aba-bbe4c622383b","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"And by the late 1800s, women's long partnerships had a name of their own: 'Boston marriages,' borrowed straight from Henry James's novel The Bostonians.","source_id":"42b9ccc6-5927-4fd7-9aba-bbe4c622383b","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"The love that dare not speak its name has, in fact, gone by many.","source_id":"66dabd79-3058-453c-b433-5c1133e80f60","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"In the 1860s a gay German writer and activist, Karl Heinrich Ulrichs, reached back to Plato's Symposium and coined 'Uranians' — people male or female in body but with the spirit of the opposite sex — a respectable label to replace 'pervert' and 'sodomite,' and the word homosexual first surfaced in an 1868 letter written to him.","source_id":"66dabd79-3058-453c-b433-5c1133e80f60","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"On New York's own streets the words were blunter — a 'fairy' was an effeminate gay man, 'queer' the catch-all, and black gay men and lesbians spoke of being 'in the life.'","source_id":"66dabd79-3058-453c-b433-5c1133e80f60","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"As for 'gay,' it first meant prostitutes — 'gay women' — before it became a code the police didn't crack until the late 1940s.","source_id":"66dabd79-3058-453c-b433-5c1133e80f60","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"By the 1950s, those words were turning into organizing.","source_id":"7073d5cc-d4d1-4455-9654-727d75ba8c96","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"The Daughters of Bilitis started in San Francisco in 1955 and put out a magazine, The Ladder, from 1956 to 1970.","source_id":"7073d5cc-d4d1-4455-9654-727d75ba8c96","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"Its first New York chapter was organized in 1958 by the activist Barbara Gittings, and from 1963 it ran out of a basement office at 26-32 Charlton Street.","source_id":"7073d5cc-d4d1-4455-9654-727d75ba8c96","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"From there the chapter pushed into the open — the 'Annual Reminder' marches at Independence Hall in Philadelphia every year from 1963 to 1969, and a 1965 picket outside the White House against the ban on gay federal employees.","source_id":"7073d5cc-d4d1-4455-9654-727d75ba8c96","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"It was one of the 'homophile' groups of the fifties, alongside the Mattachine Society, founded in 1950, and ONE, in 1954 — and they played it careful, asking members to dress the part, men in suits, women in skirts.","source_id":"7073d5cc-d4d1-4455-9654-727d75ba8c96","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"And all of it circles back to one building nearby, the movement's most sacred site — the place that once housed the Stonewall Inn, where three days of unrest in June 1969 are widely counted as the spark of the modern lesbian-and-gay liberation movement.","source_id":"e6d038af-2739-4c02-972a-6db9f94cabb8","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"One last thing, so you don't get lost down here.","source_id":"6f4aaa13-0b42-4b5b-ab96-09fa2d091e75","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":3},{"text":"Everything below 14th Street was settled first, so it never got Manhattan's tidy grid, and the streets curve, twist, and double back.","source_id":"6f4aaa13-0b42-4b5b-ab96-09fa2d091e75","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"The famous troublemaker is West 4th, which goes rogue and angles north to cross 10th, 11th, 12th, and 13th — the kind of turn that stumps even locals.","source_id":"6f4aaa13-0b42-4b5b-ab96-09fa2d091e75","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3,"also_cites":["15489e06-be3a-43f1-acea-90eeff30cf7f"]},{"text":"Learn that one break in the grid, and you'll pass for a Village pro.","source_id":"15489e06-be3a-43f1-acea-90eeff30cf7f","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3},{"text":"And on the corner of Grove Street, number 90 might look oddly familiar — it's the apartment building from Friends.","source_id":"99438222-76e5-48bc-8c35-f92891aafcfc","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":3}]}
